description: This file defines a class `GlobalVariables` that extends `Application` and functions as a singleton to store global state variables related to a driver, vehicle, weather, and location in an Android transportation management app.

classes.name: GlobalVariables
classes.description: A singleton class extending Android's Application class, used to hold global variables such as driver info, location, weather, and receipts.

methods.name: getLatitude
methods.description: Returns the current latitude stored in the global variables.

methods.name: setLatitude
methods.description: Sets the latitude in the global variables.

methods.name: getLongitude
methods.description: Returns the current longitude stored in the global variables.

methods.name: setLongitude
methods.description: Sets the longitude in the global variables.

methods.name: getDriverLastConnection
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last connection.

methods.name: setDriverLastConnection
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last connection.
